title: Configuration Deployment
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose of Configuration Deployment and define its core vocabulary.
Apply configuration deployment in a small PowerShell example and predict its result.
Identify one relevant edge case, version constraint, or troubleshooting step.

content.intro: This lesson covers Configuration Deployment in the PowerShell learning path. It expands the supplied syllabus heading into an actionable draft with a visual, a worked example, and a short knowledge check.
content.why_it_matters: Configuration management compares intended state with observed state and applies a deliberate plan. Keep configuration data separate from implementation, validate desired values, detect drift, and clearly distinguish legacy Windows PowerShell DSC, the DSC 2.0 module, and standalone DSC 3.0.
